fields.PRODUCT NAME: Rajasthani Hand-Painted Marble Haldi-Kumkum Container Set
fields.DESCRIPTION: Add a royal touch to your home with this exquisite hand-painted marble container set, crafted by skilled Rajasthani artisans. Adorned with intricate Meenakari and Kundan work, this set of two lidded jars on a decorative marble tray reflects the grandeur of traditional Indian artistry. Perfect for use as spice boxes, dry fruit holders, or pooja accessories, this piece is both functional and decorative. The rich red, green, and gold detailing, along with embedded stones, make it a stunning centerpiece for your dining table or prayer room.
